nodes.label: FALCON-512 Fast-Fourier Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 206 (FN-DSA) Category 1 parameter set utilizing Fast-Fourier sampling over NTRU lattices to deliver compact signature sizes and rapid cryptographic verification.

nodes.label: NVMe over Fabrics (NVMe-oF) RoCEv2 Memory Fabric Architecture
nodes.description: High-throughput, low-latency remote direct memory access network protocol enabling block storage disaggregation and distributed graph persistence across Converged Ethernet v2.

nodes.label: AraBERTv02 Pre-trained Language Representation Model for Arabic

nodes.label: W3C OWL 2 QL Ontology Profile Specification
nodes.description: Sub-language profile of OWL 2 designed for applications with large numbers of instances, enabling ontology-based data access (OBDA) via direct SPARQL-to-SQL query rewriting.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV) Kernel Engine
nodes.description: Core algebraic primitive computing Y = A * X over generalized semirings, underpinning single-source graph traversals and vertex score propagations in GraphBLAS.
